1. No one below 8.5k has a clue how to play this game. You included. It’s just that some people also troll or “test” their stupid builds in ranked instead of AP. Valve isn’t to blame for this, but the influencers who play on those very Axe HC and Spectre POS 4 builds just for content are very much to blame. Guardian 4 isn't the kind of tier where you can expect players to have high skill levels or play meta.

2. You don’t lose behavior points for “recommendations on where to improve.” We all understand perfectly well what behavior points are deducted for, but we lie to ourselves and others about being unfairly reported and having points unfairly deducted.

3. To avoid losing behavior points, stop using profanity, accusing others, or calling for reports. When communicating with your team, stick to only the necessary information (mainly calls and warnings like “no ult” or “no TP”). Try to maintain a positive KDA and avoid farming the jungle for 10 minutes straight since this could trigger the person reviewing the report.

4. To increase your behavior, play a lot of Turbo. Lots and lots and lots of Turbo... Mainly on supports. Buy wards, save your cores, and use save TP when needed. Behavior increases very slowly. And it’s lost just as quickly. I have 12k behavior on my main account, but on my smurf account, I raised it from 3k to 9k over about 2–3 months

Valve is not guilty, brother.
